```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
```

```{r libraries and data}
library(tidyverse)
library(readxl)
library(writexl)
template<-read_xlsx("COD Coding Input template.xlsx")
combined<-read.csv("mci_doc_combined.csv")



```

fitting combined into template
```{r fitting}
template <- combined %>%
  transmute(
    CASE_NUMBER = X,
    MANNER = cause_of_death,

   CAUSE = coalesce(
      illspec,
      drugspec,
      homispec,
      suicspec,
      selfspec,
      accspec,
      otherspec
    )
  )
write_xlsx(template, "COD Coding Input template fixed.xlsx")
```

checking the output
```{final cod}
cod_output<-read_xlsx("final_cod_output.xlsx")

cod_output%>%filter(is.na(MANNER) & is.na(CAUSE))%>%count()

#1  7688

summary(cod_output)
```
